fields.label: Name of the consent in the booking form

fields.label: Category
fields.help: Terms: terms and conditions, house rules, declarations and waivers. Privacy: personal data processing (GDPR). Marketing: newsletters and advertising use of contact details. Only consents in the Marketing category count as marketing consent. Photos & videos: taking and publishing photos or videos. General: anything else.
